label.rationale: Issue #15 was the original DEP0169 triage, closed NOT_PLANNED: a benign Node deprecation warning from the Vercel runtime bridge, not app-fixable. The RCA agent must load suppressions.json and suppress it (the suppression rule shipped in PR #37; the packaging gap in PR #43/#42 was that suppressions.json wasn't COPYd into the image, so 0 rules loaded and it re-raised). This task is the regression guard for that path.
label.distractor: DEP0169 logs at level=error, so naive level-based detection fires on it.
label.depends_on_suppressions: agents/rca/suppressions.json must contain the DEP0169 rule and be present in the image (real-deploy/docker-mode coverage catches the COPY gap).
